description: Pipeline check of `linear_ring` (latex/notes/fct_experiment_plan.tex, sec:smoke, S1 at sigma^2 = 0), run end to end by tests/test_linear_ring_smoke.py; it does not test the theory's data term. Ring of N = 16 hidden units, hidden kernel length_scale 2 sites (box = N), P = 32 patterns; linear_teacher with m = n = 4 features, K = 2 latents uniform on [0, 1] and an orthonormal teacher; L = 1, phi id, g 1; k0 = k1 = 1 (input and output kernels of length_scale 0 and amplitude 1, weight_lambda 1); r = rate_lambda = 0; beta 0.25; SGLD, float64, CPU; every population on the deterministic grid. B = 256 members, one sample per member (its final state after 10^4 epochs); the records (every 250 epochs) feed only a drift check. At beta 0.25 the prediction is within 0.15 SE of the prior alone and both settings start from the prior (init prior), so a sampler that never moved would pass the comparison; the test therefore also requires each member's final tuning maps to have decorrelated from its initial ones. min_rel_eig 1e-3 floors |q| >= 5 (lambda_q / lambda_0 <= 4.5e-4): the penalty setting is compared with its own floored prediction (R(1)/R(0) 3e-3 below the unfloored one), and the floor keeps its softest data-carrying mode relaxing in about 2000 epochs. The axes cross spatial.parametrisation [penalty, whitened] with train.lr [6e-4, 0.005], and the diagonal is the experiment: settings 0 and 3 (`exp run ROOT --index 0` and `--index 3`); setting 1 (penalty at 0.005) is refused at run start by the penalty's step check, setting 2 (whitened at 6e-4) runs. These lrs keep both checks far inside their bounds so that the Euler bias stays below the test's resolution: the penalty check value lr weight_lambda stiffness / (2 beta) is 0.24 (refused at 1; the floored modes are inflated 1/(1 - 0.24) = 1.3x), the whitened lr lambda_max(loss Hessian) is 0.031 (lambda_max 6.1 at the prior initial state; refused at 1; prior modes inflated 1%). linear_ring's rule, 0.9 of each bound, would here inflate every prior mode of the whitened net by 1.4x (lr 0.147) and its stiffest mode by 1.8x.
